_comment: The single content list for the archive. Edit this file to add, change or remove projects — nothing else needs touching. 'category' is an id from the categories list below. 'slug' is the project's own address: its detail page is generated at proje/<slug>.html. 'images' are filenames inside public/; the first is the cover the ring and the grid show, and the whole list is the detail page gallery. Small copies are generated automatically. Titles and category labels carry both languages. The ring groups cards by category in the order given here, and opens on the first one.
_placeholder: Nothing here is real Corniche content yet. Every title is a bracketed placeholder and every image is a flat tonal panel generated from the brand palette by tools/make-placeholders.mjs — there is no third-party photography in this repository. Ten projects per category and ten images per gallery are the agreed working limits. While the content is placeholders each gallery borrows its own category's ten panels; real projects will each list their own photographs.
_categoryLabels: Both languages are set to the English term, matching the agreed ring wording. Turkish readings (Çocuk Odaları, Özel Üretim Mobilya, Tekstil, Sanat, Yenileme) can replace the 'tr' values whenever wanted — one edit each, nothing else changes.
